QuestInfo.name: Pie Presentation
QuestInfo.1: Camila baked a Horny Mushroom Pie, and it actually smells pretty good! She wants to present it to Chief Stan, but no on just any old plate. Bring her a Paper Box from the Horny Mushrooms.
QuestInfo.2: You managed to get a Blue Paper Box from the Horny Mushrooms and brought it to Camila. What were they going to use it for...?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 450 Can proceed to the Gift for the Chief quest

0.0: Look, LOOK! It's done! My very first Horny Mushroom Pie! Actually, this is my first pie EVER! Oh...this is so exciting...I feel light-headed...woo... Hey, maybe I should show this to Chief Stan. This IS a really special pie and all. I just need a nice Paper Box to put it in. Horny Mushrooms have nice Paper Boxes...do you think you could get one for me?

yes.0: I know they're tough to find, but the Horny Mushrooms definitely have them! Beat them up 'till you get one!

no.0: C'mon, I just need one Paper Box! And not a store-bought one...getting items from monsters shows that you REALLY care.

1.0: This is perfect! Okay, lemme just...put the pie...in here...carefully...

item.0: I know they're tough to find, but the Horny Mushrooms definitely have them! Beat them up 'till you get one!
